in_marathi.name: Pandya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pandya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pandya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pandu', which means 'ruler' or 'king'. In Hindu mythology, the Pandya dynasty was a powerful and influential ruling family in the southern part of ancient India. The name is also associated with the Pandava brothers from the Mahabharata epic, who were known for their bravery and righteousness.
